summary: DATABASES_REGISTRY — a mountainash_settings.profiles.Registry instance holding all registered BackendSpec descriptors and their ConnectionProfile classes. Exposes @register decorator, get_descriptor(), get_settings_class(), and a backwards-compatible dict-view REGISTRY alias. Includes test seam helpers _snapshot_for_tests/_reset_for_tests.
dependents: mountainash_data.core.settings (all per-backend settings classes self-register via @register)
extension_points: @register decorator — annotate a ConnectionProfile subclass to register it with the DATABASES_REGISTRY
_RegistryDictView allows REGISTRY['sqlite'] dict-style lookup for backwards-compatible code
lifecycle_notes: All 20 per-backend settings classes auto-register on import of mountainash_data.core.settings.
documentation_hooks: The @register pattern is the extension contract for adding new databases — needs clear docs
